questions.note: Revived 2026-08-22 (G6): the round-1 chronology intercept no longer reaches this question; G1's battles-in path answers it, so it is revived with the wiki's own gold. Gold = the seven battle pages the Deep Sea King page lists under `Major Battles`. The engine returns a 19-page superset: nine extra pages match on the generic word `king` (Ancient King, Subterranean King, the character King, ...) and three more belong to a different character, `Suiryu` (the Super Fight tournament fighter). The battles-in last-word over-match is recorded in HANDOFF_ROUND2.md as a structural finding and left un-fixed per the campaign's no-.py rule.
